title: The sea
hookLine: trapped at the sea, the people panic, and Musa says: my Lord is with me, He will guide me

cards: The bill that can't be paid, and the one after it. The diagnosis. The phone call at night.
Behind you, the thing you ran from. In front, a wall. Musa has led the Children of Israel out of Egypt by night.
At sunrise, Pharaoh's army comes after them, and they reach the edge of the sea. The Qur'an says that when the two groups could see each other, Musa's people said: we are caught. It's over.
And Musa answers with one sentence.

teach.b: Surah ash-Shu'ara. Musa says: kalla. No.
Then, in Pickthall's old translation, "my Lord is with me," and he will guide me. Look at what he doesn't say. Not, I have a plan.
Not, the sea will part. He doesn't know yet what will happen. He knows only who is with him, and that the way will be shown.

teach.h: STRIKE THE SEA WITH YOUR STAFF.
teach.b: Only then comes the instruction: strike the sea with your staff. That staff again, the one he leaned on and knocked leaves down with. The sea splits, each side standing like a great mountain.
The people cross. Pharaoh's army follows them in, and the sea closes. Surah Yunus adds a detail.
As Pharaoh is drowning, he says: I believe that there is no god but the One the Children of Israel believe in. And he's told: now? When you rebelled before?
The Qur'an says his body will be kept as a sign for those after him. And this day didn't end at the shore.
A hadith in Bukhari says that when the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ came to Medina, he found the Jews there fasting on the day of Ashura.

teach.h: ASHURA — THE DAY MUSA WAS SAVED.
teach.b: He asked why, and they said: it's the day Allah saved Musa and his people.

So he fasted it too, and told Muslims to. Sunni Muslims still keep a fast on Ashura, remembering Musa at the sea. For Shia Muslims, Ashura is the day of mourning for Husayn, the Prophet's grandson, killed at Karbala.
One day, holding more than one memory.

how: Sunni Muslims keep a voluntary fast on the day of Ashura in remembrance of Musa's rescue at the sea; for Shia Muslims, Ashura is the day of mourning for Imam Husayn at Karbala.

games.q: you're with Musa at the edge of the sea. Pharaoh's army is in sight behind you. everyone is shouting: we are caught. what does Musa say?
o: no. my Lord is with me; He will guide me.
games.why: kalla, no: my Lord is with me; He will guide me. only then comes the command to strike the sea with his staff.

practice: Find the tight spot in your life right now, the place where it feels like water ahead and trouble behind, and just stand at the edge of it; you don't have to solve it.

On a slow breath out, if you pray, say: my Lord is with me; He will guide me, and if you don't, you might say: I'm not alone in this. Say it slowly, several times, and let the next step be the only one you need to see.

wordCard.voice: The sea. Water in front, an army behind, and a man who said: my Lord is with me; He will guide me. Today's word.

orig.note: Arabic, from Qur'an 26:62: "no; my Lord is with me; He will guide me."

carryVoice: Your line: my lord is with me. He knew who was with him before he knew the way. See you tomorrow.

sources.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari 2004 (the fast of Ashura and Musa's rescue)
